properties.name: Claim: cap:a-near-match-across-types-or-within-reasoning-is-a-note SATISFIES req:a-near-match-across-types-or-within-a-line-of-reasoning-is-a-note-not-a-refusal
properties.statement: The capability (a near-match of another type, or between two statements of a line of reasoning, is a note on a successful write; only a same-type match outside a line of reasoning refuses) satisfies the requirement (such a near-match is a note on a successful write, never a refusal; the same-type refusal stays with its three answers; a class test pins the rule), because the capability's behaviour is the requirement's rule clause for clause and the class test that VERIFIES both passes. This statement is the argument behind the SATISFIES edge between them, recorded as a claim so its support can be checked. PROOF OF CONCEPT 2026-10-18, case 4 (an edge that is really an argument).
